title: Annotatio VI §.I Prior Class Number: Almost one point — in/with/under bread and oral manducation, not conceded spiritual presence
pass_a_gloss: The Number, reduced almost to Unity: not concerning the real Presence and Manducation of Christ’s body and blood in the supper — supernatural and spiritual — conceded on both sides, but concerning Presence occurring in, with, and under the bread, and oral manducation of both unworthy and worthy Communicants.
pass_b_english: The disputed number shrinks almost to one point.
Both sides already concede a real supernatural and spiritual presence and manducation of Christ’s body and blood in the supper.
What remains is presence in, with, and under the bread, plus oral eating by unworthy and worthy communicants alike.
source_text: Numerum, fere ad Unitatem redactum, non de reali corporis & sanguinis Christi in coena Praesentia & Manducatione supernaturalibus & spiritualibus utrinque concessis, sed de Praesentia, in, cum, & sub pane contingente, manducationeque orali, tàm indignorum quàm dignorum Communicantium.

lemmas.gloss: in, with, and under the bread

notes: Number≈Unity; in/cum/sub + oral vs conceded spiritual presence.
